summary: Easy Day Studios' skateboarding sim focused on analog-stick foot control, real-world pro skaters, community-created spots, and a more sandbox-like approach than score-chase skateboarding games.

entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with current updates

primary.why: Skater XL left early access and released for Windows, PlayStation 4, and Xbox One in 2020, with Nintendo Switch following in 2023. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible route for the analog-control skateboarding sim, including the later online multiplayer update.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings with current updates installed; use PS4/Xbox One as console alternatives and Switch only for portable access.

all_releases.fidelity: PC release with configurable fidelity, current updates, and online multiplayer support.
